picks.title: Canva adds an AI 'off' button
picks.rationale: Concrete product change: Canva users and teams can now switch off most generative AI features and filter AI-made images, which changes team settings tomorrow.
picks.excerpt: Canva is rolling out settings that let users and teams switch off most of its generative AI features and filter AI-made images, saying AI does not suit every task; some AI tools stay on.

picks.title: What Your AGENTS.md Should Say About Your Design System
picks.rationale: New data (30 design-system repos audited, none write agent files for consumers) plus a copyable AGENTS.md section that design-system teams can use right away.
picks.excerpt: Supernova checked 30 design-system repos for AGENTS.md and other agent files: 16 have one, none is written for teams consuming the system; it proposes a section to copy.

picks.title: Pliera: a new BIM 2.0
picks.rationale: New BIM product combining modelling with AI-generated parametric objects and configurators, pitched as a Revit challenger; a distinct launch from the Snaptrude/Qonic/Rayon cards.
picks.excerpt: Pliera combines BIM modelling, AI-generated parametric objects and building configurators, with ambitious plans to challenge Revit.

picks.title: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
picks.rationale: Primary-source look at pairing frontier coding agents with Omniverse libraries to build simulation apps and iterate on designs from a prompt; adds the render/simulation category to the spread.
picks.excerpt: NVIDIA shows developers pairing frontier AI coding agents with Omniverse libraries to build simulation applications, test physical behavior and iterate on designs from a prompt.

picks.title: Too Claudified
picks.rationale: A client rejecting AI-built motion work as 'too Claudified' is a fresh, concrete signal of AI design convergence and how designers must differentiate.
picks.excerpt: A designer whose AI-built motion graphics were rejected by a client as 'too Claudified' revisits his June essay on AI design converging on one fluent look, and what changed in five months.

dedup.note: Re-curated: Smashing Magazine 'AI Sped Up The Build' removed — fetch pass found it sponsored (supported by Level Access, promotes Level CI); replaced with NVIDIA Blog 'Into the Omniverse' (render; distinct from the 10-22 NVIDIA industrial and 10-25 Cosmos cards). Dropped: Genie 4 (DeepMind) — assigned to games by curator_brief and a follow-up of the 10-28 debut. Etsy creator exodus (Creative Bloq) — reaction/extra reporting on Etsy AI policy covered 10-24/10-28, no new event. NVIDIA Cosmos two-prompt datasets — same Cosmos tooling line as 10-25 card. Not selected on score/diversity: GPT-6.2 Astra (likely cross-section, not design-specific), Gemini Mac computer use (gadgets territory), Autodesk Fusion plans (pricing/packaging), Vercel Board, Mitsubishi CNC, DEVELOP3D opinion, nTop/Eleken/Higgsfield vendor how-tos, Supernova variables-vs-tokens (evergreen; also avoids a second Supernova card), Krea Originals (movies-adjacent). Five distinct outlets; categories workflow, tokens, cad, render, figma.
